description: Alterations to the Langford Primary School (Courtyard Building) to include; installation of new foul water connections, to include minor groundworks and small diameter service penetrations through external walls; installation of CCTV cameras and associated cabling and conduit; repairs to roof; repair of existing accessible toilet to include replacement of plywood floorboards, vinyl flooring, and wall plasterboard, and installation of new pipes/gully; repair of internal timber arches; repairs to damaged plasterboard; associated external and internal works.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The works hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date on which this consent is granted.

Condition required to be imposed by Section 18(1) (a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 (as amended by section 91 of the Planning and Compensation Act 2004).

Condition : 3 - The CCTV fixings and penetrations shall, where practicable, be located within mortar joints rather than brickwork to minimise loss of historic fabric and maximise reversibility.

In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the listed building, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - Should insufficient tiles remain to complete the roof repair works, any replacement tiles should match the existing in material, colour and texture, with the retained historic tiles reused on the most visually prominent roof slopes.

In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the listed building, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 5 - All new works, and works of making good to the retained fabric, whether internal or external, shall be finished to match the original work and existing adjacent work with regard to the methods used and to material, dimensions, composition, form, colour, finish, texture and profile, and in the case of brickwork, facebond and pointing, unless shown otherwise on the drawings.

In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the listed building, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
